verdict.rationale: Dover documents e-signed offers, but the evidence shows no HRIS or payroll integration that carries new-hire data into onboarding. Webhooks, the API and CSV export are developer building blocks or manual workarounds, so they earn no credit. Handing off from an ATS to HRIS is a fair axis for a recruiting platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry
